title: Artificial Intelligence Environmental Impacts Act of 2026
action: Referred to the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, and in addition to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
summary: The Artificial Intelligence Environmental Impacts Act of 2026 is a law that aims to address the environmental effects of AI technologies by setting standards for energy use, carbon emissions, and responsible data center operations. It requires companies to report and reduce their AI‑related environmental footprint through regulations, incentives, and oversight.

title: Stop AI Price Gouging and Wage Fixing Act of 2025
action: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committees on the Judiciary, and Education and Workforce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
summary: The Stop AI Price Gouging and Wage Fixing Act of 2025 is a proposed law that seeks to curb the practice of AI companies charging excessively high prices for their services and products while also preventing them from manipulating wage structures to the detriment of workers. By enforcing transparency, setting price caps, and regulating AI‑driven labor market practices, the act aims to protect consumers and employees from unfair economic exploitation.

title: FARM AI Act of 2026
action: Referred to the House Committee on Agriculture.
summary: The FARM AI Act of 2026 is designed to regulate the use of artificial intelligence in agricultural settings, ensuring that AI tools are safe, reliable, and transparent for farmers and consumers. It establishes standards and guidelines for AI deployment in farming, covering data privacy, ethical use, and accountability to protect both producers and the public interest.

title: Unleashing AI Innovation in Financial Services Act
action: Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 619.
summary: The Unleashing AI Innovation in Financial Services Act is intended to encourage the use of artificial intelligence across banking, insurance, and investment sectors. It establishes a framework for responsible development and deployment, balancing innovation with consumer protection and regulatory oversight.

title: Unleashing AI Innovation in Financial Services Act
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.
summary: The Unleashing AI Innovation in Financial Services Act is designed to encourage the adoption and development of artificial intelligence technologies in the finance sector by providing a clear regulatory framework and incentives for innovation. It balances these goals with safeguards to protect consumers, ensure data privacy, and maintain market stability.

title: Artificial Intelligence and Innovation Talent Act
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
summary: The Artificial Intelligence and Innovation Talent Act aims to boost the U.S. AI sector by investing in education, research, and training programs. It seeks to attract, develop, and keep skilled professionals so the country remains a leader in AI innovation.

title: No AI Data Centers on Federal Lands Act
action: Referred to the House Committee on Natural Resources.
summary: The No AI Data Centers on Federal Lands Act bars the creation of AI data centers on federal property. It seeks to protect public lands and prevent potential environmental, security, and privacy risks associated with large AI facilities.

title: K–12 AI Literacy and Readiness Act of 2026
action: Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 18 - 15.
summary: The K–12 AI Literacy and Readiness Act of 2026 is a law that requires schools to integrate basic artificial‑intelligence education into their curricula so that students, teachers, and school staff are prepared for the growing impact of AI. It also allocates funding, provides resources, and establishes guidelines to help schools develop and update AI‑literacy programs.

title: K–12 AI Literacy and Readiness Act of 2026
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.
summary: The K–12 AI Literacy and Readiness Act of 2026 is a law designed to equip schools and students with the knowledge and skills needed to understand and use artificial intelligence responsibly. It provides funding, curriculum standards, and teacher training to integrate AI concepts into classroom learning, ensuring that students and educators are prepared for the increasing role of AI in society.

title: China AI Power Report Act
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations.
summary: The China AI Power Report Act requires companies and organizations that develop or use artificial intelligence systems to submit detailed reports on their AI capabilities, performance, and potential impacts. This legislation aims to increase transparency, monitor AI advancements, and ensure alignment with national security and ethical standards.

title: CREATE AI Act of 2025
action: Ordered to be Reported in the Nature of a Substitute (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 29 - 0.
summary: The CREATE AI Act of 2025 is a proposed federal law that seeks to regulate the design, use, and impact of artificial intelligence systems across the United States. It establishes rules for safety, transparency, accountability, and data protection, while encouraging innovation and protecting consumers from harmful AI applications.

title: A bill to provide for the delivery of artificial intelligence functional bills of materials, and for other purposes.
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Armed Services.
summary: This bill requires that artificial intelligence systems be accompanied by detailed functional bills of materials to promote transparency and accountability. It also includes additional provisions to support the development, deployment, and oversight of AI technologies.

title: Understanding AI in the Classroom Act
action: Referred to the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology.
summary: The “Understanding AI in the Classroom Act” is a law that seeks to guide schools and educators on how to safely and effectively incorporate artificial‑intelligence tools into teaching. It aims to educate teachers and students about AI’s benefits and risks, establish clear usage guidelines, and promote responsible, transparent AI practices in classrooms.

title: Children's Artificial Intelligence Toy Safety Act of 2026
action: Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
summary: The Children’s Artificial Intelligence Toy Safety Act of 2026 establishes rules to ensure that AI‑powered toys sold to kids are safe, reliable, and do not pose risks to their physical or emotional well‑being. It sets standards for testing, labeling, data privacy, and ongoing monitoring to protect children from harmful content or behaviors while using smart toys.

title: Expressing the sense of the House of Representatives that every American and community impacted by the construction or operation of an artificial intelligence data center should have the right to transparency and local autonomy.
action: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on the Judiciary, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
summary: The House of Representatives wants to ensure that anyone and every community affected by the building or operation of an AI data center can fully understand what is happening. They believe those communities should also have the power to influence how the data center affects them, guaranteeing transparency and local control.

title: Responsible Artificial Intelligence for Veterans Act of 2026
action: Referred to the House Committee on Veterans' Affairs.
summary: The Responsible Artificial Intelligence for Veterans Act of 2026 establishes guidelines to ensure AI systems used by the Department of Veterans Affairs are developed and deployed responsibly. It sets requirements for transparency, accountability, and safeguards to protect veterans’ privacy and promote equitable outcomes.

title: Safeguarding Against Fabricated Exploitation Through Artificial Intelligence Act of 2026
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.
summary: The Act aims to prevent the creation and use of false or manipulated AI-generated content that could be used for exploitation. It sets out legal measures to identify, regulate, and punish individuals or organizations that produce or distribute such harmful AI outputs.

title: Research and Oversight of AI in Courts Act of 2026
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
summary: The Research and Oversight of AI in Courts Act of 2026 sets up a formal program to study and monitor how artificial intelligence tools are used in the judicial system, ensuring they operate fairly and transparently. It establishes independent oversight bodies and research initiatives to evaluate AI impacts on legal decisions, protect privacy, and prevent bias in court proceedings.

title: Decoupling America's Artificial Intelligence Capabilities from China Act of 2025
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
summary: The Decoupling America's Artificial Intelligence Capabilities from China Act of 2025 seeks to reduce U.S. dependence on Chinese technology for AI development and research. It proposes restricting the import of Chinese AI components and promoting domestic alternatives to ensure national security and innovation.

title: Preventing Algorithmic Collusion Act of 2025
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on the Judiciary.
summary: The Preventing Algorithmic Collusion Act of 2025 is designed to stop companies from using AI and automated systems to secretly coordinate prices or actions that hurt competition. It establishes rules and penalties to ensure algorithms operate fairly and do not facilitate hidden collusion among firms.

title: Expanding AI Voices Act
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.
summary: The Expanding AI Voices Act seeks to broaden the range of AI applications by encouraging diverse development and deployment across sectors. It also promotes inclusive participation and equitable access, aiming to foster innovation while maintaining safeguards for all users.

title: Homestake AI Act of 2026
action: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.
summary: The Homestake AI Act of 2026 sets out rules for the safe development, testing, and deployment of artificial intelligence to protect public safety and ensure transparency. It requires certification and oversight of AI systems, imposes penalties for violations, and promotes responsible innovation.
